modelspec.diagram.ScopeKind.title: ScopeKind
modelspec.diagram.ScopeKind.description: What one segment of a scope path names (DESIGN.md § 13.2). Program is the root, the train block; Stage a PipelineStage; Function one inlining of a model function at one call site; Adjoint the gradient nodes the rule of one forward node emitted; Update the optimizer nodes of one parameter; Module and Layer are reserved for the module and layer instances of DESIGN.md § 11 iteration 3 and are emitted by no compiler before it.

modelspec.diagram.ScopeSegment.title: ScopeSegment
modelspec.diagram.ScopeSegment.description: One step of a scope path, outermost first.

name.description: The train block's name, the stage's lower-case name, the function's name, the forward value as `%<k>` or the parameter's canonical path (DESIGN.md § 2.3).

instance.description: For a Function segment, which inlining of the function in the program, from 0; 0 for every other kind.

call_site.description: For a Function segment, the source position of the call as a diagnostic prints it, `file:line:column` (DESIGN.md § 8.1); absent for every other kind.
